title: dictyogramme japonica
intro: Dictyogramme japonica, commonly known as the Japanese fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Dictyogramme japonica include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve respiratory function.
